title: adamanthus fragrans
intro: Adamanthus fragrans, commonly known as the Damask rose or Rose attar, is a perennial herb plant known for its highly fragrant flowers. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for soothing skin irritations and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Adamanthus fragrans include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as geraniol, linalool, and beta-damascenone, which contribute to its therapeutic and fragrant properties.
